BREAKING: Starlink Wi-Fi on Emirates has surpassed 1 million customer connections in just 7 months. ✈️

Passengers have already used more than 1 petabyte of data, showing strong demand for high-speed inflight internet.

The rollout now supports 60+ Starlink flights every day across 36 aircraft, including 33 Boeing 777s and 3 Airbus A380s.

Emirates plans to equip its entire fleet of 232 widebody aircraft with Starlink by mid-2027.

Fast reliable internet at 40,000 feet is quickly becoming the new standard.

A breakthrough that could make future brain-computer interface procedures even less invasive.

STARLINK IS BRINGING THE WORLD’S KNOWLEDGE TO THE UNDERSERVED

For the first time in human history, high-speed internet is reaching the most remote and underserved communities on Earth — places that have never had reliable connectivity.

Kids in rural Kenya, remote islands in Haiti, mountain villages in Bolivia, and countless other disconnected regions are now getting access to education, information, and opportunity that was previously impossible.
This is more than just internet.

It’s one of the most powerful tools ever created for lifting people out of poverty.
Elon Musk on why connectivity matters so much:

“The single biggest thing you can do to lift people out of poverty is giving them an internet connection because once you have the internet connection, you can learn anything for free on the internet.”
